title: Could a giant sunshade in space ‘solve global warming’? Scientists are taking the idea seriously
title_zh: 太空中的巨型遮阳板能否“解决全球变暖”？科学家开始认真考虑这个想法
abstract: Some say the concept is complete fantasy, but a detailed analysis suggests that the falling cost of rocket launches might make it feasible in a few decades.
abstract_zh: 有人说这个概念纯属幻想，但详细分析表明，随着火箭发射成本的下降，该设想在未来几十年内可能成为可行方案。
snippet: Some say the concept is complete fantasy, but a detailed analysis suggests that the falling cost of rocket launches might make it feasible in a few decades.
